subject: Conversion request: Jonah Price — temp->perm comp proposal
messages:
From: Jonah Price <jonah.price@contractors.pro>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: conversion to perm + compensation context

Hi Tessa,

Hope you9re doing well. I9m finishing my 10th month on the inference team this month (contract through Apex Talent). I9ve really enjoyed the work and would like to discuss converting to a full-time role if headcount and budget allow.

A few details to help the conversion discussion:
- Current contractor rate: $90/hr (W-2 through Apex).
- Target full-time base: looking for $150k-$165k depending on title and benefits. Interested in a small bonus target (~8-10%) and standard RSU package for IC3/IC4.
- Preferred start: earliest available in June but flexible for onboarding.

I9ve attached my current resume and a short note on projects (resume_jp.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call to align.

Thanks for considering this — appreciate your advocacy.

Best,
Jonah
Contractor, Inference Runtime
jonah.price@contractors.pro
Apex Talent Solutions

---
Attachment: resume_jp.pdf (PDF, 112KB)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonah Price <jonah.price@contractors.pro>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conversion to perm + compensation context

Thanks Jonah — great to hear you9re interested in a permanent role. I9ll loop in HR and Finance to confirm comp bands and headcount. Quick context from my side: Jonah has been covering a senior inference engineer scope (model runtime work, deployment optimizations, and two customer on-ramps). I9d position a conversion at IC3/IC4 depending on banding and peer comps.

Monica / Markus: can you review the attached conversion summary (I've put a rough proposed package below) and confirm whether we have budget and where this would land in the comp band? If approved, I9ll coordinate a formal offer and a proposed start date (target June).

Proposed package (manager suggestion):
- Title: Senior Inference Engineer (IC3)
- Base: $160,000
- Bonus: 10% target
- Equity: 0.02% RSU grant (4-year vest) — placeholder pending comp band
- Relocation: none
- Start: flexible June 2026

Attachments: conversion_summary.xlsx (one-pager with role context + bill-rate conversion math).

Jonah: if you have hard constraints or a competing timeline, flag them here.

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: conversion_summary.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conversion to perm + compensation context

Thanks for the context, Tessa. Reviewed Jonah9s resume and the conversion summary. Below are HR recommendations based on current Q2 bands and headcount rules.

1) Banding: For Senior Inference Engineer (IC3) the midpoint band is $155k (range $140k-$170k). For an IC4 it would be midpoint $180k.
2) Recommended offer to align with internal parity and retention: Base $158,500, 8% bonus target, RSU 0.015% (4y). This lands Jonah slightly above midpoint for IC3 and is defensible given contract tenure and customer-facing work.
3) Headcount: We need a headcount conversion approval and to create a Workday req. Please confirm cost center and budget code. Finance sign-off required for moving from contractor to perm.
4) Process notes:
   - Use the attached offer_template.docx and comp_band_q2_2026.pdf when drafting the formal offer.
   - For contractors converting, we run standard background + I-9 (if not already done through Apex). Lead time ~2 weeks.

Ask to Finance (Markus): can you confirm budget authority (cost center 4002) and whether we have runway for a base of $158.5k + on-target bonus (total comp ~171k) starting in June? If yes, I9ll draft the offer and send to Jonah with a 5-business-day response window.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: comp_band_q2_2026.pdf (PDF, 98KB), offer_template.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conversion to perm + compensation context

Monica / Tessa — budget check complete. We have capacity in cost center 4002 for headcount conversion. Approve up to $165k base for this cycle without additional exec approval; anything >$165k would need VP HR + Finance sign-off. Please proceed with the HR offer package for $158,500 base / 8% bonus / 0.015% RSU. Charge to budget code 4002-ENG-23.

One operational note: convert the contractor stop date in the vendor system the day before the new hire start to avoid dual payments; coordinate with Vendor Ops (Apex) and Finance AP.

Markus
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Inline reply from Tessa (same day):
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonah Price <jonah.price@contractors.pro>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conversion to perm + compensation context

Thanks all — approving team decision. Jonah, Monica will send a formal offer today for base $158,500 / 8% bonus / RSU 0.015% with a June start window. Please look out for the email and let us know any constraints. Excited to keep you on the team.

Best,
Tessa
